scope: Barenz--Barrett Lemma 3.4, derived from the established Lemma 3.3 law relative to its explicit standard inputs.

inherited_trusted_boundary.meaning: Lemma 3.4 starts from the actual functor-valued Lemma 3.3 law. It does not introduce a second sliding equality.

silent_failure_guards: The multiple-strand bundle is a parenthesized Boundary, not an untyped strand count.
The arbitrary exterior is a typed Diagram whose crossings, extrema, coupons, and tensor structure remain visible.
The fixed-tensor boundary adapters evaluate to identities and are proved compatible with tensorLeft.map.
The exterior transport equality is derived from Lemma 3.3 core_sound and naturality.
A wrong target boundary is rejected before evaluation.
Omitting the actual Lemma 3.3 law makes the Lemma 3.4 constructor ill-typed.
Closed evaluation is a specialization to unit-to-unit diagrams, not an assumed scalar equality.
explicit_non_claims: This does not yet define a serializable framed-link or Kirby-presentation input.
This does not prove that every two regular diagrams of one framed link are connected by the listed moves.
This does not establish all Reidemeister or presentation-independence generators.
This does not establish Kirby handle-slide or cancellation invariance.
This does not prove four-manifold invariance.
